meta.note: Hand-curated pension barèmes (RG + AGIRC-ARRCO). Approximate, flagged; the exact réglementaire coefficients belong to the data layer (spec §5.2/§5.3) and should be sourced more precisely later.

coupling.note: Point-value indexation = base indexation − k·(dependencySystem(t) − dependencySystem(base)), floored at −5%/yr. Worse demography → lower complémentaire. k kept gentle so V does not collapse and scenario differences show through. Modeling choice, not a sourced rule.
